title: Connect Finance Property Reserves v1
description: A reserve FUNDING schedule for one church-owned commercial property (3277 Ivanhoe by default), not a recurring operating statement (connect.finance-property-operating.v1) or an itemized one-off ledger (connect.finance-property-ledgers.v1) -- its own shape. Bundles three real tables production's own `finance/property/<key>` GET route already returns together (finance_property_reserves, finance_property_reserve_disbursements, finance_property_distributions); production's own finRenderPropertyTaxReserve (src/frontend/js-finance.js) renders the reserve schedule and its disbursements together under one 'Property Tax Reserve' heading. reserveKey is a generic identifier (migrations/0023's own comment documents the table as generic), even though only 'property_tax' has real rows for 'ivanhoe' today. Confirmed live against production on 2026-09-15: reserve_after_cents does not always equal reserve_before_cents + contribution_cents exactly -- 4 of 30 real rows are off by exactly +/-1 cent, pure monthly-contribution rounding.

reserves.description: One row per reserve bucket per report month. Empty is a normal, valid 'nothing recorded yet' state, not a 500.

reserveDisbursements.description: Payments made out of a reserve bucket (e.g. the annual property tax bill, once paid).

distributions.description: Confirmed cash distributions to the church for this property -- finance_property_distributions.

reserveKey.description: e.g. 'property_tax'. Generic, not a closed enum -- migrations/0023's own comment documents room for other buckets (e.g. 'capital_paint_asphalt_concrete').

taxYear.description: Only meaningful for the 'property_tax' bucket; null for others, per migrations/0023's own comment.

reserveAfterCents.description: Should equal reserveBeforeCents + contributionCents, within 1 cent of monthly-contribution rounding drift (confirmed against production's own real rows on 2026-09-15).

fundedPct.description: reserveAfterCents / targetEstimateCents * 100, or 0 when targetEstimateCents is 0. Same 0-100 scale as the committed synthetic fixture's own funded_pct.

periodKey.description: Generic period identifier -- real 'property_tax' rows use a bare tax year (e.g. '2026'), not a report month.

amountCents.description: Null when the bill has not yet been paid (confirmed against a real 2026 row on 2026-09-15).
